issues.title: Design tokens: move theme colors to CSS custom properties
issues.description:
## Goal

Every themed color, border, radius, and spacing value comes from CSS custom properties, so later UI work (and future themes) only touch tokens.

## Context

* Repo: [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>) (branch `master`, React 18 + Vite)
* `src/styles/_theme_variables.scss` defines per-theme SCSS variables; `src/styles/_themes.scss` (\~250 lines) applies them per component under `.default`, `.night`, `.amoledblack`.
* `App.tsx` puts the theme class on the root `div`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New `src/styles/_tokens.scss` declares `--color-bg`, `--color-surface`, `--color-text`, `--color-subtext`, `--color-accent`, `--color-header-bg`, `--border-accent`, `--radius-sm/md/lg`, `--space-1..6` for each theme class.
- [ ] Component SCSS files consume `var(--...)` instead of per-theme overrides; `_themes.scss` shrinks to token declarations only.
- [ ] No visual change: feed, item details, user page and settings overlay match the before screenshots in all three themes (pixel diff < 1% via Playwright `toHaveScreenshot`).
- [ ] Tokens documented in a short comment block at the top of `_tokens.scss`.

## UI expectations

Pure refactor — before/after should be visually identical. Include the side-by-side diff as the evidence.

## Validation

* `npx tsc -b`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass; add/extend vitest tests for new behavior.
* `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test` passes.
* Evidence (per `ui-pr-evidence`): before/after screenshots at 1440x900 and 390x844 in all three themes (default, night, amoled) where the change is visible, plus a short interaction video (animated webp) at the top of the PR.

## Run constraints

Demo mode. This issue is part of a repeatable demo (see **Run constraints** in project <project id="4f25bbb9-8071-4bf3-bba6-87d653a2789c" href="https://linear.app/outpostpartners/project/hn-reader-ux-refresh-3528d5a8bfb6">HN Reader — UX Refresh</project>). PRs may be opened but never merged. The issue may move up to In Review but never to Done, Canceled or Duplicate. At wrap-up, offer to reset the demo.

issues.description:
## Goal

Readers can switch theme in one click from the header instead of opening Settings.

## Context

* Repo: [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>) (branch `master`, React 18 + Vite)
* `src/components/Header/Header.tsx` (cog icon opens Settings); `SettingsContext.setTheme` already persists to localStorage and follows `prefers-color-scheme` until the user chooses.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Icon button left of the cog cycles default -> night -> amoled -> default (sun / moon / black-circle icons, inline SVG).
- [ ] Uses `setTheme` so the choice persists across reloads and the Settings panel reflects it.
- [ ] `aria-label` announces the next theme; keyboard operable (Enter/Space); visible focus ring.
- [ ] Theme change animates background/text color over 200ms (`prefers-reduced-motion` disables it).
- [ ] Header unit test covers cycling and persistence.

Button 32x32 hit area, matches cog size; visible in all themes on desktop and mobile header.

issues.description:

The feed shows the page's shape while loading instead of a centered spinner, so it feels faster.

* `src/pages/FeedPage/FeedPage.tsx` renders `<Loader />` while fetching; `src/components/Loader/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New `FeedSkeleton` renders 10 placeholder rows matching the feed row geometry with a shimmer animation.
- [ ] Shown on first load and on page change; spinner remains only as the Suspense fallback for lazy routes.

- [ ] Colors from tokens so skeletons look right in all three themes.
- [ ] Unit test: skeleton visible while the API promise is pending, replaced by rows after resolve.

issues.description:

- [ ] OP's username gets an `OP` chip.

issues.title: Empty and error states with retry
issues.description:
## Goal

When the HN API fails or a feed page is empty, readers see a friendly state with a way to recover instead of a dead end.

## Context

* Repo: [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>) (branch `master`, React 18 + Vite)
* `src/components/ErrorMessage/` (skull illustration) and `src/pages/FeedPage/FeedPage.tsx` loading/error handling (after the skeleton work lands).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Error state: illustration, short message, `Retry` button that re-runs the fetch and shows the skeleton again.
- [ ] Empty state for pages past the end of a feed: message + link back to page 1.
- [ ] Offline (`navigator.onLine === false`) shows an offline variant and retries automatically on the `online` event.
- [ ] Unit tests for error -> retry -> success and empty page.

## UI expectations

Capture each state via Playwright `page.route` (abort for error, empty array for empty, `context.setOffline(true)` for offline).

## Validation

* `npx tsc -b`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass; add/extend vitest tests for new behavior.
* `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test` passes.
* Evidence (per `ui-pr-evidence`): before/after screenshots at 1440x900 and 390x844 in all three themes (default, night, amoled) where the change is visible, plus a short interaction video (animated webp) at the top of the PR.

issues.title: CI: GitHub Actions for typecheck, unit, build and Playwright on PRs
issues.description:
## Goal

Every PR (including child-session PRs into `feature/ux-refresh`) gets automated checks, so reviews rely on green CI instead of local runs.

## Context

* Repo: [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>) (branch `master`, React 18 + Vite, Node 20 via `.nvmrc`)
* No `.github/workflows` exists today; Travis was removed in the React migration.
* Scripts: `npm run build` (runs `tsc -b`), `npm test` (vitest), `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright, `playwright.config.ts`, `BASE_URL` defaults to [http://localhost:5173](<http://localhost:5173>)).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` (any base branch) and `push` to `master`.
- [ ] Node version read from `.nvmrc`; npm cache enabled.
- [ ] Jobs: typecheck (`npx tsc -b`), unit (`npm test`), build (`npm run build`), e2e (Playwright chromium against `vite preview` or `npm run dev`, with `BASE_URL` set).
- [ ] Playwright HTML report uploaded as an artifact on failure.
- [ ] README gets a CI status badge; CONTRIBUTING mentions CI.

## Validation

* `npx tsc -b`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass; add/extend vitest tests for new behavior.
* `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test` passes.
* Link a green run on the PR.

issues.title: PWA: offline mode with cached feeds and an offline banner
issues.description:
## Goal

Readers can keep browsing feeds and stories they've already loaded while offline, and always know when they are offline or when an update is available.

## Context

* Repo: [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>) (branch `master`, React 18 + Vite, Node 20 via `.nvmrc`)
* Depends on the manifest (PWA issue) and on the empty/error state component from <issue id="aedc3281-5479-4344-8ca1-ce3eae5daf9f" href="https://linear.app/outpostpartners/issue/DAN-81/empty-and-error-states-with-retry">DAN-81</issue>.
* API: `src/services/hackernews-api.ts` (node-hnapi feeds and items).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Service worker (e.g. `vite-plugin-pwa` / Workbox) precaches the app shell; the app loads offline after first visit.
- [ ] Feed and item API responses cached stale-while-revalidate with a bounded cache (entries + max age).
- [ ] Offline banner, built on the <issue id="aedc3281-5479-4344-8ca1-ce3eae5daf9f" href="https://linear.app/outpostpartners/issue/DAN-81/empty-and-error-states-with-retry">DAN-81</issue> error-state component, shows while `navigator.onLine` is false; uncached pages show a friendly offline state with retry.
- [ ] "New version available — reload" toast when an updated service worker is waiting.
- [ ] Service worker disabled in `npm run dev` and in vitest; Playwright test uses `context.setOffline(true)` to verify cached feed and banner.

## UI expectations

The banner is non-blocking, sits below the header, and is readable in all themes on desktop and at 390x844.

## Run constraints

**Demo mode: this project is a repeatable client demo.** Every session that works on it or any of its issues, including orchestrator child sessions, must follow these rules:

* **Never merge a PR** into `master`, `feature/ux-refresh` or any other branch, in either Gated or Autonomous mode. Leave every PR open.
* **Stack instead of merging.** A child branches from its blocker's PR branch and targets its PR at that branch (or at `feature/ux-refresh` when no blocker PR is open). With several blockers, branch from one and `git merge` the others locally.
* **Never close anything.** Issues go no further than In Review (never Done, Canceled or Duplicate), and the project status stays Planned.
* Temporary changes are fine: statuses up to In Review, description edits, comments, new issues, status updates, branches, PRs, and the `feature/ux-refresh` branch. Record each one in the session's run ledger.
* **At wrap-up**, ask the user "Reset the demo now?" To reset, follow the **Demo baseline & reset** document in this project. The baseline is `master` at `67f0eb1`.

## Overview

A visual and interaction refresh of the HN reader (React 18 + Vite) in [outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>). Every issue is UI work that must ship with screenshot and video evidence in its PR (see the `ui-pr-evidence` skill in the `linear-ops` plugin).

## Repo & Branch Strategy

* **Repo:** [https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn](<https://github.com/outpostDL/angular2-hn>)
* **Base branch:** `master`
* **Feature branch:** `feature/ux-refresh` off `master`. Child PRs target `feature/ux-refresh`; one roll-up PR `feature/ux-refresh` -> `master` after **Validate: UX Refresh**.
* **Stack:** Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + React Router v6 + SCSS, Node 20

## Repo Setup

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173
npx tsc -b           # typecheck
npm test             # vitest
npm run build
BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test
```

## Waves

1. **Foundation:** Design tokens
2. **Parallel UI:** Header theme toggle, Story cards, Skeleton loading, Settings drawer
3. **Follow-ons:** Comment rails (needs cards), Mobile bottom nav (needs toggle), Empty/error states (needs skeleton)
4. **Validate:** end-to-end walkthrough + roll-up PR

## Evidence standard

Before/after screenshots at 1440x900 and 390x844 in default, night and amoled themes where visible, plus an interaction video (animated webp) at the top of each PR. The same media is attached to the Linear issue.
